from.n: web_fetch fetches public HTML, extracts text and links, and strips raw content from model output

to.n: web-fetch > text extraction > returns an HTML page's title, text and links, and keeps its raw content from the model

from.n: web_fetch blocks localhost targets before fetching

to.n: web-fetch > input > returns `blocked_url` for host names that name this machine or its network, without fetching

from.n: web_fetch validates redirect targets before following them

to.n: web-fetch > redirects > returns `blocked_url` for a redirect to this machine, its network or a private address, fetching only the first URL

from.n: web_fetch rejects DNS targets that resolve to private addresses before fetching

to.n: web-fetch > address checks > returns `blocked_url` for a host that resolves to a private address, without fetching

from.n: web_fetch rejects a resolved address it cannot read

to.n: web-fetch > address checks > returns `blocked_url` for a host that resolves to something it cannot read as an address

from.n: web_fetch rejects DNS rebinding between validation and connect

to.n: web-fetch > address checks > returns `blocked_url` when the host resolves to a private address again at connect time

from.n: web_fetch rejects non-global IP literals before fetching

to.n: web-fetch > address checks > returns `blocked_url` for IP literal hosts outside the open internet, without fetching

from.n: web_fetch rejects public addresses on this device's interface networks

to.n: web-fetch > address checks > this device's interface networks > returns `blocked_url` for public addresses on those networks

from.n: web_fetch fetches public addresses outside this device's interface networks

to.n: web-fetch > address checks > this device's interface networks > fetches public addresses outside those networks

from.n: web_fetch reads this device's interface networks again when it connects

to.n: web-fetch > address checks > this device's interface networks > returns `blocked_url` when the device joins a network between the URL check and the connection

from.n: web_fetch rejects unsupported content types without returning the body

to.n: web-fetch > response body > returns `unsupported_content_type` for a type that is not text, closing the connection unread

from.n: web_fetch rejects responses without a supported content-type

to.n: web-fetch > response body > returns `unsupported_content_type` for a response without a content type

from.n: web_fetch caps raw bytes and model text independently

to.n: web-fetch > response body > caps the raw bytes and the model's text independently

from.n: web_fetch applies timeout while reading response body

to.n: web-fetch > timeouts > returns `timeout` while waiting for more of the body

from.n: web_fetch applies timeout while resolving host

to.n: web-fetch > timeouts > returns `timeout` while resolving the host

from.n: web_fetch applies timeout while validating redirect target

to.n: web-fetch > timeouts > returns `timeout` while resolving a redirect's target
web-fetch > timeouts > returns `timeout` while connecting, having handed the connection its signal

from.n: web_fetch rejects oversized chunked size lines

to.n: web-fetch > response body > returns `fetch_failed` for a chunk size line that passes 4 KiB without ending
